title: SI NO. 4 of 2026 FISCAL INCENTIVES APPROVED ENTERPRISES (BELIZE MILLS LIMITES) ORDER, 2026
text:

BELIZE:
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
No. 4 of 2026
ORDER made by the Minister responsible for investment,
in exercise of the power conferred upon him by, section
3(5) of the Fiscal Incentives Act, Chapter 54, of the
Substantive Laws of Belize, Revised Edition 2020, and
all other powers thereunto him enabling.
(Gazetted 10th January 2026)
1. This Order may be cited as the Citation.
APPROVED ENTERPRISE (BELIZE MILLS
LIMITED.) ORDER, 2026.
2. It is hereby declared that BELIZE MILLS LIMITED Declaration
(the company), located at 1½ Miles Philip Goldson Highway of approved
enterprise.
Belize City, Belize District, is an approved enterprise under
the Fiscal Incentives Act.
3. The following persons are the shareholders of the
Shareholders.
company–
(a) ADM Caribbean Inc;
(b) Jamaica Flour Mills Limited.
4. The approved activity of the company shall be agro Approved
processing, specifically, to mill wheat into flour and bran. activities.
5. The approved categories of the company shall be as Approved
stated in the Schedule. category.
Schedule.

2 Fiscal Incentives [No. 4
Incentives. 6.– (1) The incentives granted to the company shall include
exemption from the following taxes and duties and be in
accordance with the requirements outlined under sections
5(1) of the Fiscal Incentives Act–
(a) import duty;
(b) revenue replacement duty; and
(c) excise duty.
(2) An exemption from any duty granted to the company
shall not exempt the company from any requirement under
the Income and Business Tax Act to file any return required
to be filed under that Act or the payment of any duty or tax
for which no exemption is granted to the company.
Conditions. 7. The Company may import items from the approved
Schedule. categories outlined in the Schedule, free from the duties listed
under section 6, where the items are unavailable from suitable
local products or raw materials in Belize, as determined by
the Ministry.
Incentive 8. The period granted for the incentive shall be three
Period. years, commencing on 10th January 2026 and ending on
9th January 2029.
